hero.headline: Immersive training, taught by working professionals
hero.subheadline: Complete courses you follow remotely, real-world practice, and human support at the centre in Meknès. You move at your own pace, and never on your own.

method.title: Our immersive method
method.subtitle: Four principles that make the difference between following a course and actually being able to do the job.

tile1.title: Real working situations
tile1.body: You work on the cases you will meet on the job, not on invented examples. Every module ends with a situation to handle.

tile2.title: Projects marked one by one
tile2.body: Your work is reviewed by an instructor who answers you by name, with what works and what has to change.

tile3.title: Continuous human support
tile3.body: A question rarely stays unanswered for more than one working day. You reach your instructor by message or on WhatsApp.

tile4.title: On site and remote
tile4.body: Videos and resources are available online at any hour; workshops and live sessions take place at the centre, in Meknès.

featured.subtitle: A selection of our most requested courses, updated every month.

paths.subtitle: Courses arranged in the right order, all the way to the certificate, at a bundle price.

empty.body: Paths group several courses in the right order. In the meantime, pick a course from the catalogue.

howItWorks.title: How it works

step1.title: Create your account
step1.body: A few details are enough: name, email address and phone number. You then confirm your address.

step2.title: Your account is approved by our team
step2.body: We check your details and activate your account, usually within 24 business hours.

step3.title: Choose your course and send your receipt
step3.body: Pay by bank transfer or in cash at the centre, then upload your transfer receipt from your account area.

step4.title: Access granted, you start learning
step4.body: As soon as the payment is verified, the course opens: videos, resources, quizzes and progress tracking.

howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps, from creating the account to the first lesson. Allow one working day in total.
howItWorks.note: No online payment: you pay by bank transfer or in cash at the centre.

method.title: Our method
method.lead: What “immersive training” actually means, and how your course runs with us.
method.journeyLead: From the first lesson to the certificate, here is what awaits you week after week.
method.facilitiesLead: Equipped rooms in Meknès, open to learners during opening hours.
method.accreditationsEmpty: Our accreditations will be published here as soon as they are granted.
method.ctaTitle: Would you like to talk it through before enrolling?
method.ctaBody: Write to us on WhatsApp: we will point you to the course that matches your plan, with no commitment.
method.principlesLead: These are not slogans: each one translates into a constraint we impose on ourselves, and one you can check from the very first week.

situation.title: You work on real cases
situation.body: Every module starts from a brief as it arrives in a company: a budget, a deadline, a client who changes their mind halfway. You produce the deliverable that is expected, not a classroom exercise.
situation.proof: One deliverable per module, assessed against the trade's own criteria.

projects.title: Your work is corrected by name
projects.body: An instructor reads what you hand in and answers you by name: what holds up, what does not, and the next version to produce. A mark on its own teaches nobody anything.
projects.proof: A written, reasoned correction, with a second submission allowed.

coaching.title: An instructor, not a forum
coaching.body: Your questions go to the person who designed the module, by message or on WhatsApp. You are not waiting for a well-meaning stranger to come along.
coaching.proof: An answer within one working day, for the whole of your access period.

hybrid.title: Online to learn, at the centre to practise
hybrid.body: Videos, resources and quizzes stay available at any hour, from a phone as much as from a computer. Workshops and live sessions are held in our rooms, in Meknès.
hybrid.proof: Rooms open to learners during opening hours.

step1.title: Before you start
step1.body: A short conversation: where you are starting from, what you are aiming at, and how much time you genuinely have each week. The pace is set with you, not against you.

step2.title: The first weeks
step2.body: You alternate between online modules and workshops at the centre. The first deliverable is asked for early, deliberately: fixing a mistake in week two costs less than fixing it in week ten.

step3.title: The heart of the course
step3.body: The cases move closer to the job you are aiming at. You hand in, we correct, you revise. Your progress stays visible in your space, module by module.

step4.title: The end of the course
step4.body: A complete project, presented and defended in front of the instructor. Once it is approved, your certificate is issued with a code anyone can verify on this site.

method.comparisonLead: Online tutorials are useful and we encourage you to watch them. Here is precisely what they do not do, and what we do instead.

order.aspect: The order you learn things in
order.alone: You follow recommendations at random; the gaps show up late, often in an interview.
order.centre: A built programme, where every module assumes the previous one and checks it.

feedback.alone: Nobody looks at what you produce. You have no idea what is wrong.
feedback.centre: An instructor corrects your deliverables and tells you what to redo, and why.

regularity.alone: Nothing is waiting for you: stopping costs nothing, and it happens fast.
regularity.centre: Deadlines, a group and workshops that carry you to the end.

proof.alone: A list of videos watched does not go on a CV.
proof.centre: A defended project and a certificate anyone can verify by its code.

rooms.title: Training rooms
rooms.body: Workshops and live sessions are held at the centre, in rooms kept for training.

equipment.title: Workstations
equipment.body: Workstations are available for learners who do not have a suitable machine at home.

workspace.title: Work space
workspace.body: A quiet space to push on with your deliverables between two sessions, during opening hours.

reception.title: Reception
reception.body: Reception answers questions about enrolment, takes cash payments and passes your receipts on to the teaching team.

method.teamLead: Courses are designed and corrected by practising professionals. Here is who teaches today.

about.title: About the centre
about.lead: A training centre in Meknès, born from a simple observation: you do not learn a trade by watching videos alone.
about.ctaBody: The centre is open to visits during opening hours. Let us know and we will show you around.

story.p1: The centre grew out of an observation we kept making: motivated people, dozens of hours of videos watched, and always the same inability to show an employer a finished piece of work.
story.p2: So we built the opposite of a video library: a small number of courses, each anchored in real deliverables, corrected by the person who designed the module.
story.p3: The centre is in Meknès and it is open. You can come in, sit down, ask a question out loud and leave with an answer. That is precisely what separates us from a platform.

about.missionBody: To bring every enrolled person to a piece of work they can show and defend. Everything else — the videos, the quizzes, the dashboards — exists only to serve that goal.

honesty.title: Saying things as they are
honesty.body: The prices, durations and delays we announce are the ones you will actually see. When a course does not fit your plan, we say so before you enrol.

practice.title: Doing rather than watching
practice.body: A course is judged on what you can produce at the end, not on how many hours of video it contains.

proximity.title: Staying reachable
proximity.body: One instructor, one number, one answer. The centre is a physical place and the team is there during opening hours.

followUp.title: Leaving nobody behind
followUp.body: We follow progress and get back in touch when somebody drops off, before dropping out becomes a fact.

about.centerBody: The centre hosts workshops, live sessions and end-of-course presentations. You can also pay your enrolment in cash there and hand in a transfer receipt.
about.accreditationsEmpty: Our accreditations will be published here as soon as we obtain them.
about.teamLead: A deliberately small team: the people who design the courses are the ones who correct your work.

modal.title: Request access

coupon.label: Discount code
coupon.removed: The discount code has been removed.

transferType.instantDescription: Your access is activated the same day, as soon as the receipt is verified.
transferType.standardDescription: ⚠️ Your access will only be activated once the funds are actually received, which can take up to 48 working hours.
transferType.cashDescription: Come to the front desk; your access will be activated once the payment is received.

modal.standardNotice: We recommend an instant transfer: your access is then activated the same day. With a standard transfer, access to the course is only activated once the funds have actually reached our account, which can take up to 48 working hours.

reference.label: Your request reference
reference.instruction: You must include the reference {reference} in the transfer description. Without it, verification can take longer.

upload.title: Your transfer receipt
upload.constraints: JPG, PNG or PDF · 5 MB maximum · Make sure the amount, date and beneficiary are readable.

fields.transferDateHint: The date you made the transfer.
fields.bankReferenceHint: The operation number provided by your bank, if you have it.
fields.messagePlaceholder: Anything useful for verification, if needed.
fields.confirmTransfer: I confirm that the transfer has been made

errors.receiptRequired: Add your transfer receipt to send the request.
errors.confirmRequired: Tick the transfer confirmation box to continue.
errors.transferDateRequired: Enter the date you made the transfer.
errors.transferDateFuture: The transfer date cannot be in the future.
errors.transferDateTooOld: The transfer date cannot be more than 30 days ago.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file exceeds 5 MB. Compress it, or photograph the receipt again.
errors.fileWrongType: This file format is not accepted. Accepted formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF.
errors.uploadFailed: The file upload failed. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.duplicateRequest: You already have a pending request for this course. Follow its progress from “My requests”.
errors.generic: The request could not be sent. Try again in a few moments.

success.title: Your request is being processed
success.body: We have received your transfer receipt. Our team is checking it and will activate your access as soon as the payment is confirmed. You will receive an email as soon as your course is available.
success.reviewDelay: Verification usually takes less than 24 working hours.

discard.title: Leave without sending the receipt?
discard.body: Your request is saved and your reference stays valid. You can send the receipt later from “My requests” — we will send you a reminder too.

status.pageSubtitle: Follow the verification of your receipts and the activation of your access.

empty.title: No requests yet
empty.body: Your access requests appear here as soon as you send a transfer receipt.

explanations.awaitingReceipt: Your request is recorded, but we have not yet received your transfer receipt. Send it to start the verification.
explanations.underReview: Our team is checking your transfer receipt. You will receive an email as soon as the payment is confirmed.
explanations.infoRequested: Our team needs a clarification or a more readable receipt. Read the message below, then send a new receipt.
explanations.approved: Your payment is confirmed and your access to the course is active.
explanations.rejected: Your request could not be validated. See the reason below, or write to us on WhatsApp.
explanations.expired: Your request expired because no receipt was received. You can send a new one at any time.
explanations.cancelled: You cancelled this request. You can send a new one at any time.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this request
cancelDialog.body: Request {reference} will be cancelled. You can send a new one at any time.

reupload.title: Send a new receipt
reupload.hint: JPG, PNG or PDF · 5 MB maximum · Make sure the amount, date and beneficiary are readable.
reupload.success: Receipt sent. Our team is resuming the verification.
